editorialRule: Treat liveStore as public product truth. Treat repositorySnapshot as development evidence only; never promote repository-only behavior to a live claim.

platformStatus.ios: Public GB App Store listing verified on 2026-09-22.
platformStatus.android: Public Google Play listing was not verified on 2026-09-22. audience.editorialTarget: Parents, carers and teachers of children aged 6–8
audience.usageRule: The 4+ store rating is not a recommended-age claim. Keep it separate from the editorial audience of ages 6–8.

access.download: Free to download on the verified iOS listing.
freeDailyEntitlements: one minute of Earth Shield per day
one rotating discovery mission per theme
plusEntitlements: every new hero story available that day
access.usageRule: Describe Plus as an optional in-app entitlement. Do not imply that free users lose previously unlocked stories or that new stories are generated daily.

stories.liveCatalog: The public listing describes eight recurring storybook heroes with five chapters each.
stories.liveProgression: A Radar tap unlocks a chapter; unlocked chapters remain in the Story Library. Free access provides one new story per day, while Plus makes every new hero story for that day available.
stories.fixedVsDaily: The hero/chapter catalog is fixed. Daily access is an unlock cadence, not a claim that the story catalog or fiction is generated each day.
stories.repositoryDevelopmentDifference: Development version 1.4.0+39 bundles each hero's first chapter and defines later chapter packages as downloadable immutable objects. This delivery model is not a verified 1.3.0 live-store claim.

offline.liveClaim: The store description says the app works offline with bundled stories and sample sky data.
offline.limit: Do not claim that every story or fresh live-sky result is available offline. The 1.4.0 repository's later-chapter download model is development-only evidence.

publicClaims: purchases, external links and reminder controls are behind a parent gate
processedDataSummary: purchase entitlement and transaction metadata via Apple or Google and RevenueCat
notification token, reminder time and permission state when reminders are enabled
network IP may be processed by infrastructure providers; Rockimals stores a rate-limit digest rather than the raw IP
dataAndParentControls.usageRule: Never say that Rockimals processes no data. Describe concrete product behavior, link the current privacy policy, and avoid legal-compliance or absolute-safety guarantees.

nasaBoundary.allowed: The product uses NASA near-Earth asteroid data for visitor facts.
nasaBoundary.requiredDisclosure: Rockimals is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
nasaBoundary.fictionBoundary: Animal visitors, names and stories are imaginative fiction; asteroid designations and selected measurements are science data.
